privacy_disclaimer: Bank Balance processes 100% of your financial alerts on your local device. We never ask for your online banking username, password, or SSN. No financial data ever leaves your phone.

onboarding_steps.title: Enable Text Alerts at Your Bank
onboarding_steps.instruction: Open your banking app (Chase, BofA, Wells Fargo, etc.) > Profile > Alerts & Notifications > Enable SMS/Text Alerts for Transactions.
onboarding_steps.help_tip: This allows your bank to send you an instant text alert whenever a debit, credit, or ATM withdrawal occurs.

onboarding_steps.title: Grant SMS / Notification Permission
onboarding_steps.instruction: Allow Bank Balance to read incoming bank transaction alerts on your device.
onboarding_steps.privacy_badge: 100% On-Device Processing — Zero Bank Login Required

onboarding_steps.title: Enjoy Your Automatic Passbook
onboarding_steps.instruction: Your ledger, multi-card balances, and retirement schemes are now tracked in real-time!

ui_strings.lbl_utilization_warning: Warning: Keeping utilization under 30% improves your FICO score.
